map.雨水收集量计算器，按屋顶面积与降雨量估算可收集雨水量，辅助雨水回收系统与节水规划: The rainwater harvest calculator estimates the collectable volume from roof area and rainfall, supporting rainwater recycling systems and water-saving planning.
map.每 1 mm 降雨在 1 m² 上 ≈ 1 L；收集量 = 面积 × 雨量 ×: Every 1 mm of rain over 1 m2 gives about 1 L; harvest volume = area x rainfall x efficiency
map.收集量算：录入年降雨、屋面/场地面积与径流系数，求可集雨量。: Harvest volume: enter annual rainfall, roof or site area and the runoff coefficient to get the collectable volume.
map.海绵设计：对小区录入参数，评估雨水回用潜力。: Sponge design: enter the parameters for a neighbourhood to assess rainwater reuse potential.
map.教学演示：演示径流系数（硬地高、绿地低）影响。: Teaching demo: shows how the runoff coefficient (high on hard surfaces, low on green space) affects the result.
map.：示例：年降雨 1000 mm、屋面 1000 m²、径流系数 0.9，可集=1: Example: annual rainfall 1000 mm, roof 1000 m2, runoff coefficient 0.9, so harvest = 1000*1*0.9 = 900 m3 per year.
map.径流系数取多少？: What Runoff Coefficient Should I Use?
map.屋面约 0.8–0.95、绿地约 0.1–0.3、硬地居中，按下垫面组合取。结果: About 0.8-0.95 for roofs, about 0.1-0.3 for green space and in between for hard surfaces, taken as a combination of the underlying layers.
